daily.days: UTC acquisition dates (acq_date, decision D10). Day d of a month is bit d-1 of a mask
daily.where: Only in the areas of manifest.daily: res 6 cells whose centre is in an area, and the res 3, 4 and 5 cells that contain at least one of them

fields.detail: daily = {rows, dm_modis, dm_snpp, dm_noaa20}: rows lists the row positions (aligned with mi) of the selected res 6 cells; each mask array is aligned with rows. MODIS is Terra or Aqua
fields.overview: daily = {idx, d}: idx lists the positions in cell that have daily values; d[k] is the list of [day, value] pairs of cell idx[k] for the whole cell (all its res 6 children); missing days are 0
fields.summary: daily_areas = [{name, bbox, res6_cells, daily_start, daily_h}]: per area, the value of its selected res 6 cells per UTC day to data_through

daily.rule: Before first_reference_month a cell's monthly h is spread evenly over the days set in dm_modis (h x bit / modis). From it on, each day weighs the sum over the VIIRS group of weight x bit (weights below; NOAA-20 times its scale when the scale is applied), and h is spread in proportion. The overview and summary values are the largest-remainder rounding of that split in tenths, so a cell's days sum exactly to its monthly h. Values derived from the detail masks sum to h within 0.05 per cell.
